text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Buprenorphine with naloxone started in primary care at a low first dose, then 16 mg daily, continued through any return to use; naloxone, overdose education, never using alone, and fentanyl test strips
  • Addiction medicine consultation to confirm the medication plan, choose a medicine for alcohol use disorder that can be used with buprenorphine, and set the monitoring plan
  • Alcohol care: acamprosate, thiamine, brief counseling and goals she chooses, and PEth at each check to follow drinking without relying on memory
  • Liver and infection screening: liver tests and FIB-4 at intake and six months, hepatitis C antibody, hepatitis B triple panel, and HIV test, with hepatitis A and B vaccines for a person who is not immune
  • Depression screening with the PHQ-9 at each recovery visit, a structured safety assessment with a written safety plan and the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, and safety review at every visit
  • Integrated, trauma-informed recovery plan: weekly counseling, a peer recovery coach, confidentiality she controls, and a written plan for touring, without requiring recovery to be perfect or linear

resource.title: Billie Holiday synthetic care plan
resource.description: Evidence-based, non-stigmatizing, trauma-informed primary care for a 33-year-old singer with a severe opioid use disorder and a moderate alcohol use disorder, five weeks after release from custody, when overdose risk is highest: starting buprenorphine in primary care, naloxone and overdose education, acamprosate for alcohol because naltrexone cannot be combined with buprenorphine, PEth to follow drinking, hepatitis, HIV, and liver screening with FIB-4 fibrosis staging, hepatitis A and B vaccination, depression screening with a structured safety assessment and the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, and an integrated recovery plan that continues medication through a return to use rather than requiring linear recovery, on the ASAM, SAMHSA, VA/DoD, and AASLD guidance and the CMID depression monograph.
